craft_notes: Sthāyin: weave with deviation-scaling. Rows: mass then measure. Rejected: smoothing the fixed/varied tension — killed: tension is the doctrine. Read aloud: loom rhythm.

lines: For she, thought-swollen mass-woven by free knowing's might,
thus of fixed own place-time-thing nature —
as each thing ripens true, being so;
in being-so, being-other, as it grows,
so the deed's out-kindness by degrees is fed.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sā hi samastabhāvasaṃdarbhamayī svatantrasaṃvedanamahimnā tathā niyatanijanijadeśakālabhāvarāśisvabhāvā pratyekaṃ vastusvarūpaniṣpattisamaye tathābhūtā tathābhūtāyā hi anyathābhāvo yathā yathā adhikībhavati tathā tathā kāryasyāpi vijātīyatvaṃ tāratamyena puṣyati
